## GDPR DSAR deadline monitor
Every morning at 08:00 (Europe/Berlin), reads the DSAR register and alerts `#privacy-team` in Slack about open requests that are overdue or due within 7 days.

### Setup
1. Set **registerSheetId** in **Workflow Configuration** (the same sheet as the DSAR workflow).
2. Add Google Sheets and Slack credentials.
3. Create `#privacy-team`, or change the channel in **Alert Privacy Team**.

Sends nothing when no request is at risk.
